name: Merida Scultura Endurance 4000
why_interesting: An exact-model owner review supplies a useful older 11-speed endurance build, while current official pages document a materially different 12-speed generation and a mainland list reference.
missing: Map the public R7000 review to an exact model year and generation
Claimed complete weight and numeric geometry for the reviewed older generation
No dated mainland price for the older R7000 build; current dealer stock and final transaction price remain unknown

observed_price.price_basis: official mainland suggested retail for SCULTURA ENDURANCE 4000 25

facts.complete_weight_basis: earlier-generation independent test-bike review: road.cc 2023 bike, size L/568 mm, 8,970 g reported. Configuration and weighing protocol are review-specific and do not establish the custom community build.
facts.stiffness_evidence: Independent exact-generation review found more than enough frame and fork stiffness, no detectable flex and efficient power transfer; qualitative ride assessment without an instrumented protocol

support_note: Merida's current China routes include its authorized dealer locator, official online mall, JD flagship and Douyin flagship. Its current policy requires first-owner designated-dealer purchase, valid warranty card and receipt, with service through the original dealer or a Merida store; carbon frames are covered for the first owner's lifetime. The old community build's actual seller, invoice, owner and warranty-card status are unknown, and unofficial online purchases are excluded.
source_note:
The earlier-generation CF3/R7000 community build remains separate from the current 25′ R7100 page, which lists CNY 14,800. The exact-period independent review reports about 9.03 kg and qualitative stiffness; current evidence does not price the older mainland build. UK £2,250 and Japanese ¥374,000 historical leads are foreign-market values and must not be converted or assigned to this custom/community build.

Batch 24 direct review-page recheck (2026-09-23) reads 8.97 kg for the 2023 size-L/568 mm test bike; this corrects the earlier 9.03 kg transcription. The current China CNY 14,800 MSRP belongs to the 25′ R7100 model and is not a price for this older R7000 build.
